name: sotto
description: Open-source local voice dictation for macOS — hold a key, speak, and polished text appears in any app.
author: Hao Lin

scripts.test:smoke: node test/smoke/transcribe.test.js && node test/smoke/applaunch.test.js && node test/smoke/dictation.test.js && node test/smoke/polish.test.js

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sotto uses the microphone to transcribe your speech into text.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Sotto records meeting audio locally on this Mac to transcribe your meetings.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Sotto reads your upcoming events so it can remind you what you last agreed with the people you are about to meet.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Sotto reads your upcoming events so it can remind you what you last agreed with the people you are about to meet.
